cultural.vision_reason: A woven cotton and silk tube skirt (phasin) with supplementary weft diamond bands and confronting bird motifs, a traditional Thai/Lao-Tai style garment consistent with Thai textile culture.

physical.title: skirt
physical.summary: A woman's tube skirt, a 'phasin'.  Made of four unequal sized pieces of cotton cloth with plain and polychrome bands.  Top section [9.5 cms deep] made from pieces of natural cream tabby cotton cloth.  (2) Next section [8 cms deep] has plain red tabby cotton band.  (3) The widest section [49 cms deep] has five identical diamond-patterned bands (lowest one has no zigzag border), worked in supplementary weft, using yellow silk yarn, on a red/brown tabby cotton ground (paired warps and wefts). (4) This band [25 cms deep] has a diamond patterned band, with black contronting birds in middle, worked in discontinuous supplementary weft on a red tabby cotton ground, using white and yellow silk yarns, green, blue and black cotton yarns.  Yellow silk/red cotton selvedge at hemline.  All joins hand stitched.  Some staining of top band.
